description: A version range the adapter can satisfy: it negotiates 1, declares live retrieval and as_of none, and answers a health probe. Health is one td info probe. The configured workspace assertion is reported as asserted; a live instance validates it against the database td opens before use. A replaying instance claims no physical store because a recording is not a database. Diagnostics carry only a redacted location label, never an absolute path.

placeholders.FIXTURE: absolute path of this case's fixture/ directory
placeholders.WORKDIR: absolute path of a fresh, writable, empty directory
